GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok say rail 4-5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, battled on one pace # even effort
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. moved up 3 Wide turn 1 length. just battled in Straight # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After the 1100m was hampered and momentarily taken three-wide by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside turn 4 lengths. ran on well late # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1400m had to be steadied when crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Pushed fwd & led on rail by 1/2L early . Held 3/4L lead on inside midrace & held together 3 Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & challenged @ 50m. Just held on late. Stewards - laid out in last 75m & lost on protest. blinkers off first time/ winkers first time. # Lost on protest.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Relegated from 1st to 2nd placing when Stewards upheld a protest. Shifted out passing the 75m and made contact with runner for some distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. took off 3 Wide 700 metres. 3 Wide turn 3 lengths. weakened. covered ground but # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the effort of the gelding which was on debut for its new stable, rider attributed the performance of the gelding, which was beaten 7L, to having to race three-wide throughout. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, battled on strong to the line, no match winner who was $1.12 Fav # 1 better/gap to 3rd
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarter.  Was inclined to lay out when placed under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat back 5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 3l off, held up until clear 200m and hit line well late once clear # needed room sooner
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled at the rear. Began awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with another runner. Held up from the 400m until near the 250m where it improved into a narrow run. Rdr reported that she had been instructed to ride the gelding in a more forward position, however after being slow away she elected to take it back from its wide barrier to obtain cover at the rear of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length sat back 8l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on one pace # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden more conservatively; settled back. Rdr reported after settling back as instructed from the wide barrier, his mnt travelled well through the early and middle stages, however when placed under pressure from the 500m it was one-paced and found it difficult to make up ground in the straight. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on well, no match leader/winner # breeze/leader won
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Due to a delayed arrival underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was cleared to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2-3l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, battled on strong without threatening # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from the 400m until after passing the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off 3 Wide No Cover , improved Wide turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, running on loomed up approaching 100m, kept finding the line, no match winner late # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Rdr was fined $750 under AR132(7)(a)(ii) for using her whip on 9 occasions, 4 more than permitted under the rules. In assessing penalty stewards were mindful of her poor record in relation to this rule.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length settled back 11l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began fairly, then was shifted in behind runners from its barrier.
